label: AEP-001 - Whole Study Area
scope_note: National scope. No spatial restriction; every node uses all the data its groups hold.
notes: The AEP built through Phases 3 and 4. Blank scope columns mean no restriction.

label: AEP-002 - Repparfjorden
scope_note: Bounding box 23-25 E, 70-71 N, taken from docs/NBXX-reparfjorden.qmd. 1,197 measurements across 394 sites.
notes: Spatially restricted case study. Historical submarine tailings disposal site, and the proposed Nussir ASA site. A latitude band alone was rejected: 70-71 N with no longitude bound is 3,371 measurements spanning the whole top of Norway.

label: AEP-003 - Sørfjorden
scope_note: Bounding box 59.77-60.37 N, 6.25-6.85 E, measured against load_literature_pqt the same way as A002. 760 measurements, 3 references (VannmiljøCopper2010-2025, 2003CoteurFieldContaminationOf, 2005GillanStructureOfSediment).
notes: Spatially restricted case study, site 2b. Historic Odda zinc/copper smelter and submarine tailings disposal in the inner fjord, with a well-documented recovery gradient toward Hardangerfjorden (R/data_copper_sources.R). A latitude band alone (59.5-60.5 N) was rejected on the same grounds as A002: it pulls in 24,455 measurements nationally. Inside the box: 323 marine water, 97 sediment, 45 freshwater (upstream rivers/lakes), 295 biota (150 G. morhua, 121 M. edulis, 18 A. rubens, 5 P. flesus, 1 L. limanda). No macroalgae measurements fall inside the box, so this AEP has no algae node.

label: AEP-004 - Gadus morhua
scope_note: National scope. No spatial restriction; species-focused view of the same pool as A001.
notes: Case study 3a. Organism nodes: N015-g-morhua-liver, N016-g-morhua-muscle. Same source and medium nodes as A001, narrowed to the pathway feeding this species.
